Add progress logging; retain all scanner findings and report fields

supplementalUnicodeReview.contract: Only existing runtime and primary nonempty lowercase ASCII needles shorter than chunk; .find offsets and membership, no generic Unicode-needle equivalence claim

unicodeReview.contract: Only existing runtime and primary nonempty lowercase ASCII needles shorter than chunk; .find offsets and membership, no generic Unicode-needle equivalence claim
unicodeReview.explanation: Whole and per-chunk lowercase strings can differ for Greek final sigma, which is not an ASCII needle character and has unchanged length. Relevant lowered-string positions, including U+0130 expansion, are tested directly against original str.lower().find(). Original scanner source-window indexing is preserved, not corrected or reinterpreted.
